en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard with decorative floral framing. On the left is an oval vignette showing stone ruins with large arched openings, likely from an old cathedral, surrounded by illustrated flowers. Across the upper part of the card is a panoramic view of a town along a waterfront with a church spire and a small sailboat on the water. In the center-right, stylized text reads "Hilsen fra Hamar".
